emma-customer: hi support — I signed up a few hours ago and used promo REDWOOD50 at signup but didn't get free trial credits. email verified, card did a small auth. account id acct_0x123. can you check?
jake-support: hey @emma-customer — sorry about that. can you share the email you signed up with and pm me the last4 of the card? also when did you verify email?
emma-customer: signed up with emma.forwarder@example.co.uk (it's a forwarding alias to my gmail). verified at 2024-11-02T14:12Z. card last4 4242. promo said "applied" on the checkout but credits not showing in console.
jake-support: thanks. i'm seeing a stripe auth but our autogrant webhook shows status=\"pending_review\" for that pm_token. likely reason: BIN_COUNTRY_MISMATCH + email forwarding caused detected-ip-country=GB while billing_country=US, which triggered manual-review gate. pinging payments.
liam-payments: looking now. payment logs -> pm_token=pm_abc123 status=pending_review reason=BIN_COUNTRY_MISMATCH detected_ip_country=GB billing_country=US 3DS=success but payments provider callback timed out -> race condition. our autogrant flow skipped on manual_review. repro steps: 1) sign up behind forwarding alias that resolves to different geo 2) use card whose BIN country != detected geo 3) provider 3DS callback latency causes webhook to mark review -> autogrant blocked.
maria-sre: traced the webhook path — /autogrant/webhook retry returned 500 on second attempt (trace id: https://traces.internal/trace/abc123) and the retry rate limiter dropped later attempts. :eyes:
jake-support: emma — we can do a manual grant while payments digs in. @liam-payments can we proceed with a manual credit?
liam-payments: no objections. please include account id and I'll approve the grant. we'll also follow up with a permanent fix.
jake-support: manual grant issued: +$50 credits applied to acct_0x123 (txn mg_20241102_0001). autogrant-bot: granted_by=jake-support grant_id=mg_20241102_0001 amount=50 currency=USD
emma-customer: i see the credits now, thank you! any ETA on the fix so other signups don't hit this?
liam-payments: we'll patch webhook retry behavior and relax the autogrant gating for promo-first-signups; ticket created PAY-5734, target deploy: tomorrow's deploy window.
jake-support: closing loop — if anyone else sees this pattern, please ping #payments or tag @liam-payments. :thumbsup:
_meta: generated: realistic support thread about promo autogrant gating due to email forwarding + bin-country mismatch
